ucs.title: [LLM] Patchwork (Dropping Elephant) BADNEWS loader: Office spawns rundll32/regsvr32 LOLBin chain from RTF/DOC exploit
ucs.description: Hunts Patchwork's signature initial-access → execution chain where weaponized RTF/DOC documents (CVE-2017-8570, CVE-2017-11882, EPS/Equation Editor) exploit Office to drop and proxy-execute BADNEWS/QuasarRAT loaders via rundll32.exe or regsvr32.exe from user-writable directories. This combination of Office parent + LOLBin proxy execution + AppData/Temp/Public folder is highly characteristic of the Patchwork/MONSOON intrusion set vs generic phishing.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as hashes from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","eqnedt32.exe","outlook.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe")) AND (Processes.process IN ("*\\AppData\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\Users\\Public\\*") OR Processes.process IN ("*DllRegisterServer*","*scrobj*","*/i:http*","*-EncodedCommand*","*FromBase64String*","*DownloadString*")) by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","eqnedt32.exe","outlook.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", "DllRegisterServer", "scrobj", "/i:http", "-EncodedCommand", "FromBase64String", "DownloadString", ".sct", ".hta")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentName = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend ChildName  = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,  "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentName in ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","eqnedt32.exe","outlook.exe")
| where ChildName  in ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", "DllRegisterServer", "scrobj", "/i:http", "-EncodedCommand", "FromBase64String", "DownloadString", ".sct", ".hta")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Patchwork BADNEWS Loader - Office Spawns LOLBin From User-Writable Path
id: 9a3c5b71-2e44-4c0e-a3b6-7c1d9e8f4d11
status: experimental
description: Detects Patchwork (Dropping Elephant / MONSOON) initial-access where an Office product spawns a LOLBin (rundll32/regsvr32/mshta/powershell) referencing a user-writable folder or in-memory download/decode primitive.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0040/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1218
  - attack.t1566.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\eqnedt32.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
  context:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - 'DllRegisterServer'
      - 'scrobj'
      - '/i:http'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - '.sct'
      - '.hta'
  condition: parent and child and context
  falsepositives:
    - Legitimate Office add-in installers that drop scripts to %AppData%
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\eqnedt32.exe OR *\\EQNEDT32.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE) @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\CMD.EXE) @CommandLine:(*AppData* OR *Temp* OR *Public* OR *ProgramData* OR *DllRegisterServer* OR *scrobj* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *DownloadString* OR *.sct* OR *.hta*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|eqnedt32|outlook)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|powershell|wscript|cscript|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\\\AppData\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\|DllRegisterServer|scrobj|/i:http|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String|DownloadString|\\.sct|\\.hta)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
| sort(_count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Patchwork has consistently weaponized Office exploits (CVE-2017-8570 Composite Moniker, CVE-2017-11882 Equation Editor, EPS) to drop BADNEWS, NDiskMonitor, and QuasarRAT loaders that are launched via signed-binary proxy (rundll32/regsvr32) referencing payloads in %AppData%/%Temp%/%Public%. Microsoft tracks the cluster as Patchwork; CrowdStrike as 'Quilted Tiger'; Forcepoint published the original

ucs.title: [LLM] Patchwork QuasarRAT/BADNEWS persistence: Scheduled Task + Run-key autostart from non-system path
ucs.description: Hunts Patchwork's post-install persistence pattern where the BADNEWS/QuasarRAT/Unknown Logger implant establishes redundancy via both a Schtasks-created task AND an HKCU\...\Run value pointing at a binary in %AppData%\Roaming or %Public%. Patchwork's loaders are notorious for using innocuous task names (e.g. 'Adobe', 'WindowsUpdate', 'BaiduYun') that masquerade as legitimate software (T1036.005).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="schtasks.exe" AND Processes.process IN ("*/create*","*-create*") AND Processes.process IN ("*\\AppData\\*","*\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*","*\\Temp\\*","*Adobe*","*WindowsUpdate*","*BaiduYun*","*GoogleUpdate*","*Java*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="*$" | join type=inner host user [| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as regFirstTime values(Registry.registry_value_data) as runvalue from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run*" AND Registry.registry_value_data IN ("*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*","*\\Public\\*","*\\ProgramData\\*") by host Registry.user Registry.registry_path Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)`] | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SchTaskHosts = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "schtasks.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/create", "-create")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\", "Adobe", "WindowsUpdate", "BaiduYun", "GoogleUpdate", "Java")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SchTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SchCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              SchParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let RunKeyHosts = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("RegistryValueSet","RegistryKeyCreated")
    | where RegistryKey has_any (@"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce")
    | where RegistryValueData has_any (@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\")
    | project RegTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
              RegProc = InitiatingProcessFileName;
SchTaskHosts
| join kind=inner RunKeyHosts on DeviceId
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SchTime, RegTime)) <= 60
| project SchTime, RegTime, DeviceName, AccountName, SchCmd, RegistryKey, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData, SchParent, RegProc
| order by SchTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let SchTaskHosts = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ChildName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ChildName == "schtasks.exe"
    | where CommandLine has_any ("/create", "-create")
    | where CommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\", "Adobe", "WindowsUpdate", "BaiduYun", "GoogleUpdate", "Java")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project SchTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, SchCmd = CommandLine;
let RunKeyHosts = Event
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon" and EventID == 13
    | extend TargetObject = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[3].["#text"])
    | extend Details = tostring(parse_xml(EventData).EventData.Data[4].["#text"])
    | where TargetObject has_any (@"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run", @"\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce")
    | where Details has_any (@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\")
    | project RegTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetObject, Details;
SchTaskHosts
| join kind=inner RunKeyHosts on Computer
| where abs(datetime_diff('minute', SchTime, RegTime)) <= 60
| project SchTime, RegTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, SchCmd, TargetObject, Details
| order by SchTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon ((@EventID:1 @Image:(*\\schtasks.exe OR *\\SCHTASKS.EXE) @CommandLine:((*create* OR *CREATE*) AND (*AppData* OR *Public* OR *ProgramData* OR *Temp* OR *Adobe* OR *WindowsUpdate* OR *BaiduYun* OR *GoogleUpdate*))) OR (@EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\CurrentVersion\\Run\\* OR *\\CurrentVersion\\RunOnce\\*) @Details:(*AppData\\Roaming* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Temp\\*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\schtasks\.exe$/i regex("(?i)(/create|-create)", field=CommandLine) regex("(?i)(\\\\AppData\\\\|\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|Adobe|WindowsUpdate|BaiduYun|GoogleUpdate|Java)", field=CommandLine)) OR (#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate regex("(?i)\\\\(Run|RunOnce)\\\\", field=RegObjectName) regex("(?i)(\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\|\\\\Public\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\)", field=RegStringValue))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function={ collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue]) | count() })
| _count > 1
| sort(_count, order=desc)
